note: Brief 107 (Latch, from Glint's page briefs/107/glint/weather.html; Glint tunes). Look only: no rule reads any of it. Per kind: sun (x the sun's intensity), ambient (x the trilight by day), desaturate (0..1: the sun's colour toward grey, the ambient a little cooler), shadow (x the sun's shadow strength), wet (0..1: porous ground darker and glossier), puddles (0..1: the share of flat ground at the plan's levels under water), ripples (0..1), rain (0..1: the falling streaks' density), streaks (0..1: the lamps' reflections in the wet), mist (0..1: the ground mist). mistDay and mistNight: the mist's colour.
nightNote: Glint 2026-11-11, the testbed port (Sky: 'horrible paving colors at night', 'look at the test bed ... cafe', 'this city should thrive at night'; briefs/107/glint/testbed-port/). The testbed's café night is a dark base under many warm pools (moon 0.18, sky 0.12, exposure 1.05, warm lamps, terrace wall lights, palm uplights, sign emissive 3.2). nightIndirect 0.6 -> 0.8: less of the day's baked bounce (the grey dusk). night: ambient and moon x the old town's night trilight and moon; lamps (every night lamp, carried and the play look's) x lampScale, range x lampRange, leaned to lampColour by lampShare, teal-hued pools (rehueFrom..rehueTo deg, the teal table lamp) to rehueColour; uplights at the foot of each tree named upNames; the grade over the carried night grade: shadowsNeutral takes its teal shadow tint back toward neutral (the teal wash on the paving), temperature warms the pools, contrast and saturation are added to the grade's own. Tune on a built player with -weatherJson <loose copy> -night.
